why: 1) SENTENCE EXISTS. whats-new/2026-w20.md line 87 (Other wins grid, single-sentence div): "MCP stdio servers now receive CLAUDE\_PROJECT\_DIR in their environment, matching hooks, and plugin configs can reference \${"{"}CLAUDE\_PROJECT\_DIR{"}"} in commands". De-escaping the MDX (\_ escapes and the {"{"} brace-literal trick) yields the claimed quote exactly; the whole line was read and there is no second clause reversing it. 2) CITED CODE SAYS SO. packages/shared/src/mcp/client.ts:373-401 -- the stdio branch splits on config.pluginRuntime: plugin servers go to SupervisedStdioClientTransport, everything else builds env: { ...processEnv, ...getProxyEnvVars(), ...config.env } where processEnv is process.env minus BLOCKED_ENV_VARS. No project-dir variable is added. packages/shared/src/plugins/data-paths.ts:127-134 confirms the plugin-only injection (exact line is :132, not :131 -- :131 is CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR). 3) CONSEQUENCE VERIFIED SEPARATELY, ONE LAYER UP AND DOWN. Up: native/project .mcp.json entries take the resource branch in mcp/runtime-pool-servers.ts:~452-465 -> parseMcpServersDocument, and mcp/project-config.ts:106 expands command/args/env/url/headers against `const environment = process.env` only; nothing in packages/ or apps/ assigns process.env.CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR or process.env.NESSY_PROJECT_DIR (grep -a, whole repo, excluding node_modules/dist/bundled resources -- the only CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR literal outside plugin code is capabilities/native-sources.ts:726, an unrelated '.claude' directory constant, i.e. the sibling-symbol trap, and it is not this). Down: mcp-pool.ts:1112-1145 connect() -> sdkConfigToClientConfig (mcp-pool.ts:429-482, passes config.env straight through) -> new NessyMcpClient; there is no other spawn seam. The Claude SDK backend does NOT spawn stdio MCP itself -- claude-agent.ts:1136-1148 hands the SDK only in-process session tools plus createSourceProxyServers backed by the same McpClientPool, so client.ts is the single spawn authority and nothing upstream supplies the variable. NOT an owner decision: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-07-29-inert-worklist.md section 3's nine dated decisions are SEATBELT_TESTING_WILDCARD, availableModels/enforceAvailableModels, autoMode.classifyAllShell, ManagedDeliveryStateV1.drops, plugins/hooks-runtime.ts, SdkMcpServerConfig.required, SessionMirrorStore.delete, MirrorSessionKey.subpath/listSubkeys, and listSessionSummaries/listSessions -- none touch the project-dir env. NOT a rename or product difference either: the Nessy spelling NESSY_PROJECT_DIR is not injected for these servers any more than the Claude one is, and the host demonstrably knows the project root (capabilities/runtime-skill-content.ts:137 resolves projectDirectory: ['NESSY_PROJECT_DIR','CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR'] for skills). Two corrections to the claim's wording are in correctedState.
correctedState: Confirmed, with two corrections to the claimed state. (a) claudeCompatPluginEnv (packages/shared/src/plugins/data-paths.ts:127-134) emits CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR ONLY -- not 'NESSY_PROJECT_DIR + CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR'. Nothing in the repo emits NESSY_PROJECT_DIR into any process env (pluginRuntimeEnv at :98-105 emits only the four PLUGIN_ROOT/PLUGIN_DATA spellings). The CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR entry is line :132; :131 is CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR. This makes the gap slightly WIDER than claimed, and exposes a second defect the finding did not name: format-adapters/claude.ts:2708-2711 rewrites a Claude plugin manifest's ${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR} to ${NESSY_PROJECT_DIR} at import, but no layer supplies NESSY_PROJECT_DIR, so a Claude-plugin MCP command referencing the project dir resolves to NEITHER spelling -- contradicting the data-paths.ts:123-125 comment which asserts 'both resolve to the same validated path'. The spawned plugin process does still carry CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR in its environment, so the doc's first clause holds for plugin servers; only the in-command ${...} reference is broken. (b) An unresolved reference in a project .mcp.json does not 'resolve to nothing': expandConfigVariables (mcp/server-config-values.ts:51-65) defaults to unset: 'literal', so the command keeps the literal ${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR} text and project-config.ts:202 warns 'references unset environment variables with no default'. The server therefore starts with a bogus literal path rather than a blank one. Net state: native and project .mcp.json stdio MCP servers receive no project-dir variable under either spelling; only Claude-profile plugin MCP servers do, and for them only as spawn env, not as an expandable ${...} token. The doc's 'matching hooks' comparison is also unmet on the hooks side in this fork -- buildHookCommandEnv (automations/hook-command.ts:46-80) inherits only HOME/PATH/SHELL/TMPDIR/TEMP/TMP plus NESSY_* event fields and the plugin actionEnv, so a native hook gets no project dir either; the fork is internally symmetric (project dir is a plugin-runtime-only concept) but diverges from Claude for both hooks and MCP.
